categories.main_business_segments: Zhang Xiaoquan Inc. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of modern household hardware products, focusing on three main segments: cutting tools (including household and industrial scissors and knives), kitchen hardware (such as cookware, bamboo and wooden kitchen utensils, and kitchen appliances), and home hardware (including personal care tools and garden hardware). The company has expanded its product matrix to cover diverse household scenarios, leveraging its historic brand in the cutlery industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced core technologies in cutting tool manufacturing, including heat treatment, continuous stamping, anti-rust integrated cleaning, multi-blade sharpening, and automated production lines with robotic arms. It has developed proprietary technologies protected by 134 patents and operates intelligent factories with automated, information-driven, and lean production systems. R&D focuses on materials innovation, ergonomic design, digital sharpening, and automated polishing techniques to enhance product quality and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Zhang Xiaoquan serves a broad customer base including household consumers, industrial users, retail chains, e-commerce platforms, and overseas markets. Its products are sold through multiple channels such as online direct sales, offline wholesale and retail, and export markets, with key customers including large supermarket chains, regional distributors, and cross-border e-commerce buyers. The company targets both domestic Chinese markets and international markets like Southeast Asia, Australia, and Russia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, and Yangjiang, Guangdong Province. Its sales network covers nationwide domestic markets extensively and also includes overseas markets such as Southeast Asia, Australia, and Russia. The company actively expands its presence in emerging e-commerce platforms and international trade channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhang Xiaoquan operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and sales. It sources raw materials like steel and plastics, manages OEM partnerships for semi-finished and finished goods, and controls quality through in-house inspection and supervision. The company also provides direct sales and distribution services to end consumers and retailers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on expanding its product matrix around cutting tools and metal household products, emphasizing consumer scenario-based product development. R&D priorities include materials innovation (new steel types, antibacterial coatings, titanium alloys), process automation, digital manufacturing, and ergonomic design. The company aims to build a comprehensive patent portfolio, lead industry standards, and enhance product differentiation through continuous innovation and technology upgrades.
categories.revenue_model: Zhang Xiaoquan generates revenue primarily through product sales across multiple channels including direct sales (both online and offline), distribution via dealers, and consignment sales. Online sales are conducted through proprietary e-commerce stores and third-party platforms, while offline sales include retail stores, wholesale markets, and export trade. The company also earns income from financial investments and government subsidies related to its manufacturing activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading and historic brand in China’s cutlery and household hardware industry, recognized as a top kitchen hardware brand and a national time-honored brand. It competes in a fragmented market with many small and medium enterprises but maintains competitive advantages through brand strength, technological innovation, and extensive sales channels. The company is among the top players driving industry consolidation and premium product development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Zhang Xiaoquan reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 908 million, representing an 11.87% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 25 million, with a stable earnings per share of RMB 0.16. The company has a total asset base near RMB 994 million and equity attributable to shareholders around RMB 635 million. It has demonstrated steady revenue growth driven by core product segments, especially cutting tools, and maintains positive cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhang Xiaoquan emphasizes its heritage as a century-old, nationally recognized brand with a reputation for high-quality, reliable cutting tools and household hardware. Its value proposition centers on superior product performance, ergonomic and aesthetic design, and technological innovation supported by extensive patents. The company differentiates itself through integrated smart manufacturing, diversified product lines tailored to consumer scenarios, and a robust multi-channel marketing network that enhances customer experience and brand loyalty.
